config.note: Replay: recorded analyze reply and writer tokens with recorded timing; resolver on the local alias table (no RxNav); rx_facts=None, so the RxNorm facts branch returns no facts and the writer prompt has no [r] blocks; no answer cache exists in this build.
config.regen_note: Grounding questions replayed in the three modes. A regenerated request replays the first recording a second time (the second attempt's prompt differs, its text is not recorded), so its latency is the cost of a second writer call, not a measurement of the strict prompt.

sse.note: Time to first visible sentence in `stream` mode over SSE. Not part of AT-3.
